result.edit: The failure shows a mismatch in divider config=1 where the output was 1 when expected to be 0 during odd period mode. The issue was in the odd-period comparison where div_o was being right-shifted by 1 (dividing by 2) instead of 2 (dividing by 4) to match the even-period case. This change makes the odd-period comparison consistent with the even-period logic by using >>2 for both cases, as specified in the waveform contract.
